title: Eefo Etho Totem
description: This makes totem look like the legendary Eefo.
body: This pack turns the totom of undying into the legendary eefo build from guess the build. When you make a mistake and the totem pops you will hear Ethos voice saying "Oh snappers!" Hope you enjoy having eefo with you. The totem is based off of the well known content creator Ethoslab from Hermitcraft and the life series. This doesn't change anything but the totem sound and look.
